decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the use of the properties known as 349 - 351 London Road.
Condition : 6 - The expanded A1 retail unit hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the the hours of 7.00am to 11.00pm.
Condition : 7 - The window formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 8 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east or west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, shop front and conversion of two shops into one.
